classification: Stable source observation contracts, not runtime qualification or empirical performance claims.

contracts.question: Are zeros fresh and are stages progressing without forwards?
contracts.activation: Opt-in lifecycle interval>0, sample_every1 and bounded capacity sufficient for retained cohort; native PP1/CP1 P4+D16 normal/overlap path must be tested. Delivery must pass actual native concurrent-writer capture; flags and empty producer loss counters alone are insufficient.

decision.if_observation_A: Fresh empty queues with progress: investigate supply.
decision.if_observation_B: Fresh occupied queues without progress: inspect stages/holders. Stale or silent: unknown; repair activation.

limits: Freshness applies to named queue totals only.
scheduler_run_batch_count includes prebuilt placeholders; zero delta excludes all run_batch calls.

contracts.question: Who holds request and metadata rows?
contracts.activation: Opt-in lifecycle interval>0, sample_every1 and bounded capacity sufficient for retained cohort; native PP1/CP1 P4+D16 normal/overlap path must be tested. Delivery must pass actual native concurrent-writer capture; flags and empty producer loss counters alone are insufficient.

decision.if_observation_A: Young advancing owners: consider capacity/service tradeoff.
decision.if_observation_B: Old or cancelled holders: diagnose progress/cleanup before capacity.

limits: Row0 padding versus metadata0 valid; session retention and unbound rows explicit.
Physical/shared KV bytes unobserved; tracked resource rows are not a byte ledger.

Schema2 request_generation distinguishes repeated RID/room lifetimes within one process; retry/chunk transitions on the same Req keep their generation. Legacy schema1 histories cannot establish this distinction.

contracts.question: Did cancellation release resources at the actual safe transition?
contracts.activation: Opt-in lifecycle interval>0, sample_every1 and bounded capacity sufficient for retained cohort; native PP1/CP1 P4+D16 normal/overlap path must be tested. Delivery must pass actual native concurrent-writer capture; flags and empty producer loss counters alone are insufficient.

decision.if_observation_A: Release observed and slot reused: do not blame a retained row.
decision.if_observation_B: Cancelled holder awaiting drain/consensus: examine cleanup dependency; omission under loss is unknown.

limits: Host destination timeout cannot authorize release before drain.
Terminal state is distinct from physical release; session retention is a valid branch.

contracts.question: Which observed stage prevents admission/progress?
contracts.activation: Opt-in lifecycle interval>0, sample_every1 and bounded capacity sufficient for retained cohort; native PP1/CP1 P4+D16 normal/overlap path must be tested. Delivery must pass actual native concurrent-writer capture; flags and empty producer loss counters alone are insufficient.

decision.if_observation_A: Transport locally successful but metadata absent: inspect metadata visibility/gate.
decision.if_observation_B: Handshake or capacity guard observed: inspect that stage and its owners; no matching peer record remains a gap.

limits: No extra readiness calls or GPU reads; hook reuses existing result.
Transfer submission is not wire-start; no wire-byte progress.
Native diagnostic must reconstruct deliberate stall and real healthy P/D completion.

contracts.question: Is the retained cohort complete enough to choose an action?
contracts.activation: Opt-in lifecycle interval>0, sample_every1 and bounded capacity sufficient for retained cohort; native PP1/CP1 P4+D16 normal/overlap path must be tested. Require actual same-pipe stdout/stderr descriptor proof before downstream multiplexing and native concurrent mixed-stream capture to the consumer. Flags, PIPE_BUF atomicity and empty producer loss counters alone are insufficient.

decision.if_observation_A: Fresh correlated cohort without relevant loss: apply conditional rule.
decision.if_observation_B: Sampled/truncated/lost/unsupported history: bound uncertainty and repair diagnostic before repeating dependent full trials.

limits: Max requests/events/history/oldest/pools and four async sink batches bound memory/output.
Permanent sink failure or process death can prevent final drop report.
PP/CP/PDMux paths require separate qualification. Concurrent-writer support requires external native collector receipt; unit framing success alone is insufficient.
Frame checksums/sequence identify corruption and observed gaps; missing final whole records require process/collector closure receipts.
8MiB record maximum; fragments are single writes bounded by PIPE_BUF. Sink errors/drop totals can themselves be lost on process death.

Separate stdout/stderr capture can interleave inside atomic producer frames downstream. Native same-stream tests alone do not establish mixed-stream delivery; qualification belongs to the actual collector path.
